parameters.description: The intensity of the process. Higher values create stronger physical impacts within the erosion process.

parameters.description: Controls the horizontal spread of the anastomosis effect. Larger values produce wider channels and features.

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: Determines the vertical extent of the erosion. Higher values result in deeper cuts and more pronounced terrain features.

parameters.name: Downcutting
parameters.description: Specifies the style and aggressiveness of vertical erosion. Select from various modes to control how the terrain is carved downward.

enumValues.name: Riversx4

enumValues.name: Flooding

nodes.name: Aperture
nodes.description: Aperture expands or compacts every feature on the terrain, similar to a camera's bokeh.

implTypeResolution.evidence: exactly one candidate class in Gaea.Nodes.dll declares [Toolbox(NodeCategory...)]

parameters.name: Information
parameters.description: Displays additional information or metadata about the aperture operation and its current settings.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Specifies the morphological operation to apply to the input, affecting how features are expanded or contracted.

enumValues.name: Dilation
enumValues.description: Expands or grows features in the input by the specified shape and size, filling small holes and connecting nearby elements.

enumValues.name: Erosion
enumValues.description: Contracts or shrinks features in the input by the specified shape and size, removing small details and separating connected elements.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: Sets the size of the structuring element (aperture) used for the operation. Larger values increase the effect's reach.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.description: Determines the geometric shape of the structuring element used for dilation or erosion, affecting the style of the transformation.

enumValues.name: Disk
enumValues.description: Uses a circular (disk-shaped) structuring element for smooth, rounded transformations.

enumValues.name: Polygon
enumValues.description: Uses a regular polygon as the structuring element, allowing for custom-sided shapes.

enumValues.name: Asterisk
enumValues.description: Uses a star or asterisk-shaped structuring element, emphasizing cross-like or radiating effects.

enumValues.name: Line
enumValues.description: Uses a straight line as the structuring element, applying the effect directionally.

enumValues.name: Corner
enumValues.description: Uses a corner-shaped structuring element, targeting angular or edge features.

parameters.name: Vertices Count
parameters.description: For polygon shapes, sets the number of vertices (sides) used, controlling the regularity and appearance of the structuring element.

parameters.name: Corner Angle
parameters.description: Specifies the angle of the corner for the 'Corner' shape, adjusting the sharpness or openness of the structuring element.

parameters.name: Direction
parameters.description: Sets the orientation or direction for directional shapes (such as Line or Asterisk), controlling the angle of the effect.

parameters.name: Antialiased
parameters.description: If enabled, applies antialiasing to the aperture operation, smoothing the edges of the transformed features for a cleaner result.

nodes.name: Bomber
nodes.description: Bomber takes an input heightfield and "stamps" or bombs it across the entire terrain surface using the randomization properties you set.

implTypeResolution.evidence: exactly one candidate class in Gaea.Nodes.dll declares [Toolbox(NodeCategory...)]

parameters.name: Iterations
parameters.description: Number of instances the bombing operation will create. Higher values increase the number of scattered elements.

parameters.name: Multiplier
parameters.description: Quickly multiply the number of bombed instances by increasing or decreasing this value, scaling the overall density.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The minimum and maximum relative size of bombed instances, allowing for variation in the scale of each element.

parameters.name: Size Distribution
parameters.description: Controls the uniformity of the size of bombed instances. Higher values produce more consistent sizes, while lower values allow greater variation.

parameters.name: Rotation
parameters.description: The minimum and maximum range of rotations for the bombed instances, introducing random orientation for each element.

parameters.name: Proportional
parameters.description: Determines whether instances should maintain height-to-size proportion. When enabled, scaling an instance will also scale its height proportionally.

parameters.name: Variable Height
parameters.description: Allows variations in the height of bombed instances, introducing additional randomness to their elevation.

parameters.name: Height
parameters.description: The minimum and maximum range of height variations for the bombed instances, controlling how tall or flat each element can be.

parameters.name: Distribution
parameters.description: The method used to distribute bombed instances across the surface.

enumValues.name: Random
enumValues.description: A randomized distribution that results in pure chaotic patterns, scattering instances unpredictably.

enumValues.name: Grid
enumValues.description: A normalized grid distribution function that results in a systematic, evenly spaced pattern.

parameters.name: Jitter
parameters.description: The random offset applied to each instance while distributing, adding natural variation to their placement.

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different distribution patterns.

parameters.name: Fade Edges
parameters.description: Softens the edges of bombed instances, blending them more smoothly into the base terrain.

parameters.name: Blend Mode
parameters.description: Specifies how the base terrain and bombed instances are merged together.

enumValues.name: None
enumValues.description: Each instance overwrites the underlying terrain at its location.

enumValues.name: Blend
enumValues.description: Blends instances with the base terrain using standard blending.

enumValues.name: Add
enumValues.description: Adds the height values of instances on top of the base terrain.

enumValues.name: Subtract
enumValues.description: Subtracts each instance from the base and previous instances, creating depressions.

enumValues.name: Difference
enumValues.description: Creates a difference between the base and each bombed instance, emphasizing changes.

enumValues.name: Multiply
enumValues.description: Multiplies the base terrain with each bombed instance, modulating the result.

enumValues.name: Screen
enumValues.description: Adds the two inputs without overexposing the output, resulting in a lighter blend.

enumValues.name: Max
enumValues.description: Retains the maximum height values of each bombed instance and the base terrain.

enumValues.name: Min
enumValues.description: Retains the minimum height values of each bombed instance and the base terrain.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: The level of quality to be used for the bombing operation. Draft is recommended for high-resolution previews, while Medium and High provide better final results.

enumValues.name: Draft
enumValues.description: Fastest processing with lower quality, suitable for previews.

enumValues.name: Medium
enumValues.description: Balanced quality and performance for general use.

enumValues.name: High
enumValues.description: Highest quality with the most detail, recommended for final output.

parameters.name: Add Input
parameters.description: Allows an additional input to be included in the bombing operation, enabling more complex or layered effects.
